name: feature.campaign-autopilot.nodes
description: Campaign autopilot node pack (ADR 0961). `preflight` reads the typed checklist of what the run's campaign still needs; `start-stage` starts a stage (v0.1: the drafting stage) as its own campaign run. Both go through ctx.features['campaign-autopilot'], which takes the campaign only from the run's own tag, never an input. While a blocking preflight item is missing the run waits on a checklist card (a clarification interrupt) until "Check again" finds it ready (1.1.0, ADR 0961 P1).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Campaign autopilot: Preflight
nodes.description: Checks what the run's campaign still needs before the autopilot drafts it: the brief exists and is complete, the brief's setup (brand, persona, knowledge), the client's ad account when the brief runs ads, and a goal. Read-only. Output: { ready, items[] } where each item is { id, status: ok|missing|warn, blocking, missing? }. Suspends on a checklist card while a blocking item is not ok; "Check again" re-reads it.

nodes.label: Campaign autopilot: Start stage
nodes.description: Starts one autopilot stage as its own campaign run, tagged with the same campaign (role `stage`), and completes with that run's id. config.stage names the stage (`drafts`: the campaign spine, which drafts the messaging kernel and every channel behind their review gates). Inputs: { provider?, model? }. Output: { stage, runId, workflowId }. A retry resolves the same run; a replay starts nothing.
